insights.name: Canonical order impact — latest 1h and 24h cohorts
insights.description: Latest fresh snapshot per window; no rows means telemetry unavailable. Cohorts end 2 minutes before observation. Accounts are Trading Accounts, not browser IDs. Pending orders remain explicit.
insights.query: SELECT toInt(attributes.window_seconds)/3600 AS window_hours, argMax(toInt(attributes.total_orders),timestamp) AS orders, argMax(toInt(attributes.expired_orders),timestamp) AS expired, argMax(toInt(attributes.active_accounts),timestamp) AS accounts, argMax(toInt(attributes.affected_accounts),timestamp) AS affected_accounts, argMax(toInt(attributes.repeat_affected_accounts),timestamp) AS repeat_accounts, argMax(toInt(attributes.pending_orders),timestamp) AS pending, round(100.0*expired/nullIf(orders,0),2) AS expired_percent, max(timestamp) AS observed_at FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND service_name='plether-keeper' AND resource_attributes.`deployment.environment.name`='sepolia' AND body='keeper_order_reliability_snapshot' GROUP BY window_hours ORDER BY window_hours

insights.name: On-chain failure reasons — last 24h
insights.description: Log observations, not deduplicated orders. Unknown reasons before the projection deployment remain explicitly labeled. Use canonical snapshot counts for impact.
insights.query: SELECT coalesce(attributes.terminal_reason,'NOT_EXPORTED') AS reason, count() AS log_observations FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND service_name='plether-keeper' AND resource_attributes.`deployment.environment.name`='sepolia' AND body='keeper_order_finalized_failed' GROUP BY reason ORDER BY log_observations DESC

insights.name: Preparation and recovery problems — distinct attempts, 24h
insights.description: Distinct attempt UUIDs, not traders. Recovery retries are deduplicated within each reason; reasons may overlap. Browser telemetry can be blocked or absent.
insights.query: SELECT event, properties.reason_code AS reason, count(DISTINCT properties.attempt_id) AS attempts, count() AS observations FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND properties.deployment_name='sepolia' AND properties.attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND properties.attempt_id != '' AND ((event='perps sponsored operation' AND properties.reason_code='DEADLINE_TOO_CLOSE') OR (event='perps preparation recovery' AND properties.reason_code IN ('RECOVERY_CLOCK_MISMATCH','PREPARATION_UNUSABLE','RECOVERY_TIMEOUT'))) GROUP BY event,reason ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: Alert metric — hourly expiry rate (minimum 20 orders)
insights.description: Initial alert threshold: greater than 5 percent; hourly checks. Zero when fewer than 20 orders; no rows when snapshot stale. Enable notifications after backend rollout. Based on all order types.
insights.query: SELECT if(toInt(attributes.total_orders)>=20,100.0*toInt(attributes.expired_orders)/nullIf(toInt(attributes.total_orders),0),0) AS expiry_percent FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND service_name='plether-keeper' AND resource_attributes.`deployment.environment.name`='sepolia' AND body='keeper_order_reliability_snapshot' AND toInt(attributes.window_seconds)=3600 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

insights.name: Alert metric — repeatedly affected accounts, 1h
insights.description: Initial alert threshold: greater than 2 accounts; hourly checks. Counts accounts with at least two expired orders in the matured hourly cohort. No rows when telemetry is stale.
insights.query: SELECT toInt(attributes.repeat_affected_accounts) AS repeat_accounts FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND service_name='plether-keeper' AND resource_attributes.`deployment.environment.name`='sepolia' AND body='keeper_order_reliability_snapshot' AND toInt(attributes.window_seconds)=3600 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

insights.name: Telemetry missing — snapshots in last 10 minutes
insights.description: Initial alert threshold: fewer than 1 snapshot. Check every 5 minutes after deployment. Zero means no recent aggregate telemetry, not zero failures.
insights.query: SELECT count() AS recent_snapshots FROM logs WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND service_name='plether-keeper' AND resource_attributes.`deployment.environment.name`='sepolia' AND body='keeper_order_reliability_snapshot'
